payout_quote: It costs nothing to get your spot live on our app and website - we only charge our competitive commission fee after the spot has sold. SpotHero charges 35% on all reservations.
steps: Fill out the Sell Parking form on SpotHero.com; Seller Support evaluates whether your spot is a good fit, then you agree to the Terms of Service and provide payment information.
For new sellers, offer 24/7 Monthly Parking for at least 6 consecutive months upon signup; you set the price (SpotHero can recommend competitive rates).
Manage availability, rates, and reservations in the Seller Control Panel; drivers book on demand and your spot auto-rebills monthly until the customer cancels.
SpotHero collects all revenue for the month and remits your earnings via direct deposit in the first 7-10 business days of the following month, minus the 35% commission.
catches: SpotHero takes 35% of every reservation - one of the highest cuts in the asset-rental lane; you keep 65% of a price you set.
New sellers are ONLY accepted for 24/7 Monthly Parking with at least 6 consecutive months of availability upon signup - you cannot list a driveway for a few hours or just weekends anymore.
Reservations are on demand and cannot be pre-approved: customers can book up to the minute before parking, and your spot must remain available to active-reservation customers at all times.
You are responsible for honoring reservations; consistently unavailable spots get delisted.
Earnings are location-driven: near stadiums, airports, downtown cores and colleges command real money; a suburban driveway may get zero demand.
Revenue arrives monthly (7-10 business days after month end) - slow first cash flow.
Rental income is taxable; check local rules/HOA on commercial use of residential parking.
biggest_catch: SpotHero keeps 35% of every booking and only accepts new sellers offering 24/7 monthly parking for 6+ months, so you lock in your spot long-term, can't pre-approve drivers, and earn only if your location has real parking demand.
eligibility: Own or control a parking spot; new sellers must offer 24/7 monthly availability for at least 6 consecutive months. Pass SpotHero's seller review; agree to Terms of Service. Legacy hourly/event sellers grandfathered with blackout controls.
timing: Listing free; approval-based onboarding. Payouts are monthly via direct deposit in the first 7-10 business days of the month. First revenue requires driver demand at your location.
